name: Pipeliners - Search Atlas Zero-Click Prompt 2026-07-22
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-07-22

# Summary
A prompt written for the Search Atlas agent to fix 8 pages that earn impressions but no clicks. It is not for writing new pages.

# The problem it states
GSC, 90 days to 2026-07-22: 98 clicks, 58,060 impressions, 0.40% CTR, average position 28.4 (US only 0.15% CTR, position 47.1).

# Pages in order
/what-is-cipp/ (7,263 impressions, 0 clicks, position 74), /how-plumbers-use-cured-in-place-pipe-lining.../ (4,819), /glendale/ (3,513), /reline-vs-replace.../ (2,848), /phoenix/ (2,418), /tempe/ (2,072), /buckeye/ (1,726), /mesa/ (1,570). /epoxy-pipe-lining/ was excluded because it was declining for an undiagnosed reason.

# Rules it gives
- Titles 50-60 characters, keyword first, a specificity hook, "| Pipeliners", city in the first 40 characters for city pages.
- Metas 155-160 characters with one concrete specific and a soft CTA.
- AEO "ski ramp": direct answer first, question H2s with 1-2 sentence answers, no hedging, entity density, Key Takeaways at the end, everything in raw HTML.
- GEO: genuinely local specifics per city page, NAP matching GBP, links to service pages and 2-3 neighboring cities.
- Schema must match visible content; internal links with descriptive anchors.
- Platform note: titles in Rank Math, H1s and schema in OTTO.

# Superseded points (check before reuse)
- It lists pipe bursting as a service (Pipeliners does not offer it).
- It says titles live in Rank Math; Rank Math was later found deactivated and OTTO owns titles and metas.
- It gives the GBP number (480) 447-5345 as the NAP phone; the copy phone is now (480) 535-6503.
- It suggests price ranges as specifics; new copy may not include prices.
